# **ENGLISH**

**🎉 The first stop of the Ruta Cubera arrives in Tlaxcala! 🏆🧩**  

Attention, speedcubers! 🚀 Tlaxcala will be the epicenter of cubing with the **NxN Tlaxcala 2025** competition. Get ready to showcase your speed, challenge the best times, and enjoy an event full of excitement.  

🔹 Official NxN events  
🔹 WCA-sanctioned competition  
🔹 Limited spots – sign up now!  

If you want to be part of **Ruta Cubera** history, this is your chance! 📍🔥  

This is a WCA-approved competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
